## What changed

Describe the user-facing change and link the related Issue or original source.

## Evidence

- [ ] Case sources point to the original creator or official reproducible example.
- [ ] Prompt text, when present, is complete and verbatim; missing prompts remain `null`.
- [ ] Tutorial commands, versions, hardware notes, expected output, and rollback steps were checked against linked sources.
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording are attached for visual changes.
- [ ] No `.review/` data, credentials, signed URLs, or downloaded media were committed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run validate:data`
- [ ] `npm run skills:verify`
- [ ] `npm run build`

Add any browser, media Range, or deployment checks that reviewers should repeat.
